faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good with kids?
faq.a: Some do very well with children, but behavior varies by individual and supervision matters. Never leave a baby or young child unsupervised with any dog.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good family dogs?
faq.a: They can be, for families who are home a good part of the day. Frenchies are affectionate and adaptable, but they need company, moderate exercise, a cool home and attention to their health.

A UK veterinary-record study found lower adjusted odds of recorded aggression in French Bulldogs, but that does not predict the safety of an individual dog. Growling, guarding or bites warrant proper evaluation.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good with cats?
faq.a: Some live peacefully with cats after careful introductions, but there is no guarantee based on breed alone. Give cats safe escape routes and supervise introductions.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs good guard dogs?
faq.a: Not really. The AKC says they are not a particularly vocal breed, and their small size and friendly nature make them companions rather than guard dogs.
